tool.name: Get.otulabels
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$infile.otu' infile.otu.dat && ln -s '$accnos' accnos.dat &&
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #if $infile.otu.is_of_type("mothur.cons.taxonomy"): #silent $mothur_args.append("constaxonomy=infile.otu.dat") #end if #if $infile.otu.is_of_type("mothur.otu.corr"): #silent $mothur_args.append("otucorr=infile.otu.dat") #end if #if $infile.otu.is_of_type("mothur.axes"): #silent $mothur_args.append("corraxes=infile.otu.dat") #end if #if $infile.otu.is_of_type("mothur.list"): #silent $mothur_args.append("list=infile.otu.dat") #end if #if $infile.otu.is_of_type("mothur.shared"): #silent $mothur_args.append("shared=infile.otu.dat") #end if #if $infile.intype == "in_shared" and $infile.label: #silent $mothur_args.append("label=" + str($infile.label)) #end if #silent $mothur_args.append("accnos=accnos.dat")
echo 'get.otulabels(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log

param.label: Which type of files will you be supplying?
shared/list - allows you to input a list file you wish to select OTUs from.
label - pick (one) OTU Label
param.help: By default first label in your file is used

param.label: cons.taxonomy/otu.corr/axes file
param.help: constaxonomy file can be obtained by the running classify.otu tool, otucorr from otu.association tool, and corraxes from corr.axes command

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The get.otulabels command selects otu labels from the output from classify.otu_, corr.axes_ and otu.association_. This can be useful especially with subsampled datasets or when groups have been selected.
.. _classify.otu: https://mothur.org/wiki/classify.otu/ .. _corr.axes: https://mothur.org/wiki/corr.axes/ .. _otu.association: https://mothur.org/wiki/otu.association/
